rates.name: Streamer Payout Rate
rates.notes: Creators receive flat $0.01 USD (1 cent) per Bit cheered on eligible Affiliate or Partner channels

rates.name: Viewer Purchase Markup (Web)
rates.notes: Twitch takes its cut upfront from viewers; 100 bits cost $1.40 USD on desktop web (higher on iOS/Android due to app store fees)

notes: Official Twitch Cheering and Bits revenue share policy. Streamers receive a fixed $0.01 USD per bit cheered regardless of viewer bundle discounts.
